body.x: PABLO AIR (CEO Youngjoon Kim) participated in ‘Pre-CES2025 Incheon (IFEZ)’ on November 13 at the Grand Ballroom C of Songdo Convensia.

Known for its innovation in drone technology, PABLO AIR develops autonomous swarm control technology and integrated mobility management platforms. Its ecosystem integrates multiple crewless vehicles using diverse communication protocols into a single system, allowing various drones to share information in real-time and collaborate on complex tasks. The company uses this technology to offer solutions across multiple industries, including defense, drone art shows, drone delivery, and urban air mobility (UAM) traffic management platforms.

At CES 2025 in Las Vegas, PABLO AIR will exhibit its performance drone lineup, PabloX, in the main LVCC pavilion. The company aims to expand partnerships, increase sales, and secure drone shows and systems orders. Developed with proprietary domestic technology, PabloX aims to demonstrate its global competitiveness. Visitors can also experience its award-winning UAM traffic management platform, UrbanLinkX, which offers a glimpse into future urban lifestyles.

PABLO AIR has advanced beyond traditional LED drone shows by creating unprecedented-performance drones. In April 2024, it set a Guinness World Record for “most unmanned aerial vehicles launched with fireworks,” with a show featuring 1,068 drones.

Holding patents for fireworks drones in South Korea and the U.S., the company has developed a diverse range of drones under its PabloX brand. The PabloX F40, emphasized as the world’s first multi-purpose drone with an integrated fireworks system, reduces technical errors caused by additional equipment attachments and enhances operational efficiency through unified design.

body.cap: PABLO AIR’s ‘PabloX L20’ showcased at Pre-CES2025 in Incheon (IFEZ). | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Earlier this year, PABLO AIR unveiled the PabloX F40 at CES 2024, marking its official entry into the U.S. market. Initial meetings with partners during the event led to the company’s first export deal. The PabloX F40 has received FCC certification and FAA flight approval in the U.S., officially recognizing its quality and reliability. The drone has also garnered significant interest across Asia and the Middle East, with purchase intent letters steadily arriving.

The company stated, “The PabloX series offers an eco-friendly entertainment solution that can replace traditional fireworks. Designed to be easily adopted by non-drone companies, it simplifies the execution of drone art shows. Notably, the newly introduced PabloX Smart CLS is an innovative system that allows simultaneous charging, logistics, and storage for multiple performance drones. This system significantly reduces operational costs and labor requirements, addressing the inconvenience of individually storing, transporting, and setting up drones for shows.”

body.x: Organized by the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority (IFEZA) and Incheon Technopark, ‘Pre-CES2025 IFEZ’ is part of the ‘Global Top 10 City Incheon Week’ held in the third week of November. Integrating five related events, the event focuses on key themes like healthcare, bio, and smart cities. On November 13, the IFEZ Smart City Tech Conference and the CES2025 Incheon Pavilion showcase occurred concurrently.
